name: NexGrid Catalog Gallery
author: Hakan GERMAN

sections.description:
English:
NexGrid Catalog Gallery is a lightweight solution to transform your WordPress site into a professional product gallery. Version 3.9.4 refines “Root Category” matching, ensuring your product catalog remains completely isolated from other content like news or blog posts. It leverages native infrastructure (Posts & Categories) for maximum speed and SEO compatibility. No complex setups or heavy e-commerce frameworks required.

Türkçe:
NexGrid Catalog Gallery, WordPress sitenizi saniyeler içinde profesyonel bir ürün kataloğuna dönüştüren hafif ve hızlı bir çözümdür. 3.9.4 sürümü ile gelen “Ana Kategori” seçimi sayesinde, ürün kataloğunuzu sitedeki haber veya blog yazılarından tamamen ayırabilirsiniz. Standart “Yazılar” ve “Kategoriler” altyapısını kullanarak veritabanınızı yormaz, maksimum hız ve SEO uyumluluğu sağlar. Karmaşık e-ticaret sistemlerine ihtiyaç duymadan ürünlerinizi sergilemenize olanak tanır.

Built on WordPress Native Features

Uses standard WordPress Posts and Categories. This ensures maximum performance and ease of use without cluttering your database with custom post types or heavy frameworks.

Donate

If you find NexGrid useful and want to support its development, you can buy us a coffee! Any support is greatly appreciated.

Eğer NexGrid eklentisini faydalı buluyorsanız ve gelişimine destek olmak isterseniz, bize bir kahve ısmarlayabilirsiniz! Desteğiniz bizim için çok değerli.

Donate / Bağış Yap
sections.installation:
Upload the nexgrid-catalog-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.

Access settings via the ‘NexGrid Catalog’ menu.

Select your “Root Category” to define where your products start.

Place shortcode [ngcgal_catalog] on any page.
sections.changelog:
3.9.4

Fixed: Root category matching and sub-category visibility issues.

Fixed: Inline JavaScript execution to ensure sidebar menu clicks always work.

Improved: Product rendering logic under sub-categories.

3.9.0

Feature: Added Root Category selection in settings to filter specific product groups.

Feature: Added support for root attribute in shortcode [ngcgal_catalog root=”12″].

3.8.0

Final production release.

Updated default branding colors to corporate blue.

Unified all prefixes and shortcodes for WordPress.org compliance.

short_description: Lightweight product catalog with tree view and responsive grid. Easily filter products from blog posts using root category.
